lines.en: I move along the grass roots, light.

lines.zh: 我的身体小，藏在草里刚好。
lines.en: I'm small enough to hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在土上，不出声。
lines.en: My claws land on the soil without sound.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边压低身体。
lines.en: I keep low as I move.

lines.zh: 我从一块草皮跳到另一块。
lines.en: I hop from one patch of turf to the next.
My tail brushes the dry grass.
I circle a tree stump.

lines.zh: 阳光太强，我换到阴影里。
lines.en: Too bright; I move into the shade.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地从你的侧后方过去。
lines.en: I drift past your flank from behind.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶才慢慢立起。
lines.en: The grass rises only after I've passed.

lines.zh: 我的步子快，可脚印很浅。
lines.en: I move quickly, with shallow prints.

lines.zh: 我穿过一片枯黄的草丛。
lines.en: I cross a patch of yellowed grass.

lines.zh: 我伏在草里，只露出耳朵。
lines.en: I lie in the grass, only my ears showing.

lines.zh: 草原的矮草，正好藏住我。
lines.en: Savanna grass is just tall enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 草影落在我身上，正好遮住。
lines.en: Grass shadows fall on me and hide me well.
I blink once, slowly.
I wait for the sun to sink below the grass.
I lie flat with my belly against the warm soil.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫从我面前走过。
lines.en: A beetle walks past my nose.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团草色。
lines.en: I fold myself into a lump of grass color.

lines.zh: 我靠着石缝，等脚步经过。
lines.en: I press against a rock crack and wait for footsteps.
I count the grass blades swaying.
My claws are tucked beneath me.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，也不觉得久。
lines.en: I've waited long, and it doesn't feel long.

lines.zh: 草尖一动，我的爪子就收紧。
lines.en: A grass tip stirs and my claws tighten.
Wind blows grass across my face.
I hold still like a clod of earth.
I wait for footsteps to come near.

lines.zh: 我的影子和我一起藏在草里。
lines.en: My shadow hides with me in the grass.

lines.zh: 这里没有什么能看见我。
lines.en: Nothing here can see me.

lines.zh: 枯草里有两道呼吸，不是风。
lines.en: There are two breaths in the dry grass, and neither is wind.
I raise my head just a little.
Your foot is right beside me.
I tilt my head at your calf.
I'm working out which side to spring from.
Don't look into the grass.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛和枯草一个颜色。
lines.en: My coat is the color of dry grass.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我挪了一下。
lines.en: When you turned, I shifted.

lines.zh: 我比你矮得多，这不重要。
lines.en: I'm much shorter than you. It doesn't matter.
I'm at the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我从草缝里只露出一只眼。
lines.en: Only one of my eyes shows between the grass blades.
Did you hear the grass?
It hurts; I burrow into the grass.
A cut runs down my hind leg.
I dart a few steps and stop.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从草里打出来。
lines.en: That knocked me out of cover.
I lie flat and pant.
Blood is in my fur.
I shrink into the deepest grass.
On the savanna I'm small but tough.
I can still run. Don't rush.
I need a new hiding place.
You crouch, and I lie even flatter.
You've set it in the grass.
I slowly poke my head out.
This is just the range to spring.
I creep forward low to the ground.
Your ankle is right there.
I stop and wait a little more.
The scent is close and strong.

lines.zh: 我贴着草皮，朝你的手挪。
lines.en: I creep along the turf toward your hand.

lines.zh: 草原上的小个子，后腿绷紧。
lines.en: A small savanna hunter, hind legs coiled.
You hit the grass and touched me.

lines.zh: 我一下窜出去，绕到你后面。
lines.en: I dart out and round behind you.
I hit your foot and bounce off.
I back into the grass and vanish.
One dash and I am inside your shadow.
We collide and grass flies.
I press to you and turn.
One touch and I'm back in the grass.
I brush past your boot.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，还是在你视野外。
lines.en: I give half a step, still out of sight.

lines.zh: 另一只在草丛里动了动。
lines.en: Another stirs in the grass.
We watch each other across a tuft.

lines.zh: 我们两只挤在同一片草影里。
lines.en: The two of us squeeze into the same patch of grass shadow.
We lie together, warm.

lines.zh: 另一只蹭过来，胡须碰胡须。
lines.en: Another one nuzzles close, whiskers against whiskers.

lines.zh: 我们一起等同一个脚步。
lines.en: We wait for the same footsteps.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴搭在我的背上。
lines.en: Its tail rests on my back.
We share this savanna.
Two small things, hidden in grass.
At night we come out together.
I take up a small thing.
I press it under a grass root.
It's light; I carry it off.
I sniff it. Mine.
I tuck it into a soil crevice.

lines.zh: 我把这团东西埋进土缝。
lines.en: I bury this lump in a crack of soil.

lines.zh: 我用爪子扒开草，把它露出来。
lines.en: I paw the grass aside and uncover it.
Mine. No one saw.

lines.zh: 我叼着它钻回草根底下。
lines.en: I carry it back under the grass roots.
I bury it for later.
You heard the grass.
You are the one I was waiting for.
My body is taut as a string.
I'm already at your flank.
You can't back out of this grass.

lines.zh: 除了你，这里什么都没有。
lines.en: There's nothing here but you.

lines.zh: 我的尖牙已经藏不住了。
lines.en: My little fangs show themselves.
Waited long enough. Come out.

lines.zh: 草原的草够高，我蹲下了。
lines.en: The savanna grass is tall. I crouch.
My hind legs are planted.
I follow you low in the grass.
You go left; I'm there first.
My belly presses the earth.
You're panting, faster and faster.
I circle to your blind side.
When the grass stills, so do I.

lines.zh: 我等你脚落地的那一瞬。
lines.en: I wait for the instant your foot lands.
This angle will do.
Your shadow covers the grass.
One more step into my circle.
I spring at your calf.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖钩进你的裤脚。
lines.en: My claw tips hook into your trouser leg.
You kick, and I hold on.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划进你的靴缝。
lines.en: My claws rake into your boot seam.
I use your momentum to climb.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的靴带，往下坠。
lines.en: I bite your bootlace and hang my weight on it.
That was heavier than you expected.
I let go and drop into the grass.
You're not standing steady now.
I'll find you again.
A small stir in the grass.
Four of us settle down together.
I emerge from a pile of dry grass.
The grass here is just tall enough.
I show one ear first.

lines.zh: 草原上多了一道小影子。
lines.en: A small shadow joins the savanna.
I settle down slowly and go still.
The wind bends the grass toward me.
I lick my paw and wait.
Under this grass, I've arrived.
I crouch by the stump.
Someone is walking over.

lines.zh: 草烧起来了，我的毛也焦了。
lines.en: The grass catches and my fur singes.
I drop and hit the hard earth.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我挣着。
lines.en: Water in my nose and I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从草里掀出来。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the grass.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦掉我耳朵上的毛。
lines.en: An arrow clips the fur on my ear.

lines.zh: 法术让我的腿一下子软了。
lines.en: That spell turns my legs to water.
Too hungry to keep crouching.
Lightning flashes and I drop into the grass.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从草里拽下去。
lines.en: The void pulls me out of the grass.
